verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS code-review platform, but the evidence pack documents no export feature, bulk data download, or account-exit path. Related items do not establish an export capability: greptile.json config files kept in the repo, MCP or CLI access to individual PR comments, and self-hosting where logs stay on customer servers. These are adjacent features, not a way to export all of a user's data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
